new: New baselines: Claude Sonnet 5, GPT 6 Sol, LLama 4 Maverick and Qwen3.8-27B.
The metadata graph now includes the hierarchical structures of the OData tables (e.g. municipality X is part of province Y).
Non-pivoted SQL is now the main query format of the benchmark; pivoted SQL is kept as an ablation.
fixes: Ambiguous questions in the English and Dutch test sets were rewritten or removed (308 English and 299 Dutch questions).
Models that fail to generate a query now score 0 on all metrics, instead of the question being ignored.
Several fixes to the gold SQL queries and the selection metrics.

new: Initial setup of the LOCuST codebase and dataset.
